description: This source file provides functions for generating time-related string representations, including local time, UTC date-time with extended precision, and UTC date-time in standard format, for a trace buffer structure.

methods.name: void tr2_tbuf_local_time(struct tr2_tbuf * tb)
methods.description: Populates the buffer in the tr2_tbuf structure with the current local time formatted as HH:MM:SS.microseconds.

methods.name: void tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime_extended(struct tr2_tbuf * tb)
methods.description: Populates the buffer with the current UTC date and time in an extended ISO 8601 format including microseconds and a 'Z' suffix.

methods.name: void tr2_tbuf_utc_datetime(struct tr2_tbuf * tb)
methods.description: Populates the buffer with the current UTC date and time in a compact ISO 8601 format including microseconds and a 'Z' suffix.
